Fix: remove the `body` return (unused). Let me patch.

Also, the fuzz generator's `body` var was per-stream leftover. Just return None.

Also note: my `_bodylen` uses total data for the sid, which is only right when the stream is structurally valid (all data counted). For forwarded streams all DATA is counted, so it's fine.

arguments.command: cd /workspace && sed -i 's/    return {.routes.: ROUTES, .events.: out}, body/    return {"routes": ROUTES, "events": out}, None/' tmp/fuzz.py && grep -n "return {" tmp/fuzz.py | head -3 && python3 tmp/fuzz.py 7 2>&1 | tail -20
